adversarial_cases: Last birthday debtor bankruptcy creates no unanswered decision
Exact TURN_ENDED recovery and pending decision recovery preserve the original five-turn trajectory
Recovered pending decisions do not duplicate decision_started
All suite and batch fixtures are screened before client creation
Missing, empty, and start-only decision logs fail replay
Net-worth ties ignore the selected winner
Conflicting later commits cannot partially mutate canonical journals
Interior action and decision gaps cannot be appended out of order
Identity and treatment rejection occurs before journal repair
Fractional and string-valued bids fail schema validation before scoring
Completion requires its final marker and full inventory hashes
Micro provider failures close clients and preserve unresolved-call accounting
Real counteroffer histories identify the opposite party and preserve normalized prompt history
Unknown costs propagate through decision, player, model, run and campaign reports
Repeated API starts preserve existing run artifacts and full treatment identity
Jail-exit birthday events identify the debtor rather than the card drawer
Known no-key/auth/rate-limit rejections recover with a new physical call ID while preserving and accounting for prior calls
Timeouts, server errors, in-flight calls and gaps in physical-call history block resubmission
Five-turn recovery reuses successful calls after failures before commit, action append, resolved decision append and during event append
Budget and preflight changes preserve campaign cell identity; actual treatment changes invalidate it
Post-hoc review annotations do not invalidate completion; canonical evidence changes still do
Unknown action or resolved-decision rows reject recovery before any journal changes
Partial cost coverage preserves known spending and stops both batch and campaign execution before the next game
Batch leaderboards count each model cost once per run, and batch summaries/model cards preserve unknown costs
Budgeted all-baseline campaigns complete multiple cells with zero provider calls; historical empty totals count as zero only with explicit zero-attempt and complete-coverage evidence
